name: Magic Rings
mechanism: Layered luminous rings expand, fade and rotate; ring spacing, radius growth and two colors shape the field.
adaptation: Original elliptical ring waves use seed-derived phase and frame time. No pointer-follow, hover scale or click event; only decorative choreography behind content.

name: Laser Flow
mechanism: An energetic beam bends into a vertical stream with luminous wisps, haze, flow speed and falloff.
adaptation: Original SVG right-angle beam with analytic downflow wisps and restrained glow; no mouse tilt or live fog simulation. It does not demonstrate a real physical beam or system flow.

name: Magnet Lines
mechanism: A regular grid of short lines rotates toward a changing focal location.
adaptation: An analytic moving attractor orients original line geometry from seed and frame, not a real cursor. Existing text and evidence are not rotated.

name: Antigravity
mechanism: Small particles react to a magnetic field, forming displaced rings with depth and pulsing variation.
adaptation: Original capsules bend away from a scheduled moving field using closed-form positions. No physical-state integration, actual input tracking, or upstream particle engine is used.

name: Ribbons
mechanism: Layered, tapered ribbons trail a moving point with spring-like offset, varying thickness and age-based fading.
adaptation: Original filled ribbon polygons sample an analytic path at earlier parameter values, without retaining earlier frames or tracking a user's pointer. Decorative trails do not alter source content.

name: Meta Balls
mechanism: Moving soft ball fields merge into connected organic contours; count, size and clumping determine the silhouette.
adaptation: Original seeded orbiting circles use an SVG blur/alpha contour filter to merge. There is no cursor ball or claim of a functional upstream shader implementation.

name: Star Border
mechanism: Luminous highlights travel around a container perimeter while its content remains in a separate inner area.
adaptation: Two original star-shaped highlight trains move analytically along the stage perimeter. This is a decorative border, not a button, link or real status indicator.

name: Pixel Trail
mechanism: A moving point leaves square, grid-quantized marks that decay with age.
adaptation: Original square afterimages sample a scheduled analytic trajectory; no real cursor events, history-dependent canvas or content images are used.

name: Noise
mechanism: Fine film-grain samples refresh at a controlled interval, creating an animated noise texture.
adaptation: Original low-opacity SVG grain is regenerated from seed plus a frame-derived tick. No unseeded random source or browser timer is involved, and noise stays behind readable content.

name: Shape Blur
mechanism: Simple shape silhouettes or outlines change local edge softness around a moving circular influence region.
adaptation: An original rounded outline and ring receive a moving analytic soft-focus mask. Only decorative geometry is softened; evidence text, screenshots and the presenter remain intact.

name: Crosshair
mechanism: Horizontal and vertical guide lines converge on a moving focal point with a cursor-like crosshair.
adaptation: Original guide geometry follows a seeded analytic path, never the real cursor, camera, eyes or hands. It is decoration and does not establish real tracking or selection.

name: Click Spark
mechanism: Short radial segments expand from a point, ease outward and fade over a finite burst duration.
adaptation: Original scheduled starbursts derive center, age and radius from seed and frame. No actual click is inferred, and bursts do not claim an action or task was completed.

name: Pixel Transition
mechanism: Staggered grid pixels obscure and reveal alternating visual surfaces.
adaptation: Original pixel shutters exchange two abstract color fields using analytic phase offsets. They never swap real source media, proof images, text, or application states.

name: Glare Hover
mechanism: An angled luminous reflection band traverses a bounded surface, suggesting polished material.
adaptation: Original SVG sheen moves on a repeating frame-addressed sweep. No hover state or interactive card behavior is implied, and the sheen stays behind the semantic layer.

name: Sticker Peel
mechanism: A sticker-like surface lifts at one edge with a curled reverse side, lighting and fold shadow.
adaptation: An original abstract sheet with a neutral ring motif curls on a seeded schedule. No upstream drag widget, image, logo, testimonial or unapproved sticker asset is reproduced.
